# Data Preparation

## Load and Prepare the Dataset

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Read the raw dataset

cbcl_long_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  "C:/Users/15280/OneDrive/文档/2025 Summer Project/data/mh_p_cbcl_tscores.xlsx"
) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

n_raw_subjects <- cbcl_long_raw %>%
  dplyr::distinct(participant_id) %>%
  nrow()

cbcl_long <- cbcl_long_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    subjectkey = participant_id,
    eventname  = session_id,
    cbcl_scr_syn_anxdep_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__anxdep_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_withdep_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__wthdep_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_somatic_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__som_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_social_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__soc_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_thought_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__tho_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_attention_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__attn_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_rulebreak_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__rule_tscore,
    cbcl_scr_syn_aggressive_t = mh_p_cbcl__synd__aggr_tscore
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time = dplyr::case_when(
      eventname == "ses-00A" ~ "baseline",
      eventname == "ses-01A" ~ "1y",
      eventname == "ses-02A" ~ "2y",
      eventname == "ses-03A" ~ "3y",
      eventname == "ses-04A" ~ "4y",
      eventname == "ses-05A" ~ "5y",
      eventname == "ses-06A" ~ "6y",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(time)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(time != "6y") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time = factor(time, levels = c("baseline", "1y", "2y", "3y", "4y", "5y"))
  )

n_after_timefilter_subjects <- cbcl_long %>%
  dplyr::distinct(subjectkey) %>%
  nrow()
```

## Dichotomization of Symptom Variables

```{r}
# Define 8 CBCL syndrome scale T-score variables
symptom_vars_t <- c(
  "cbcl_scr_syn_anxdep_t", "cbcl_scr_syn_withdep_t", "cbcl_scr_syn_somatic_t",
  "cbcl_scr_syn_social_t", "cbcl_scr_syn_thought_t", "cbcl_scr_syn_attention_t",
  "cbcl_scr_syn_rulebreak_t", "cbcl_scr_syn_aggressive_t"
)

# Dichotomization: T-score >= 65 indicates clinically significant symptoms
# Cutoff threshold: 65
cbcl_long_bin <- cbcl_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(symptom_vars_t),
      ~ if_else(.x >= 65, 1L, 0L, missing = NA_integer_)
    )
  )

cat("Dichotomization threshold: T-score >= 65\n")
cat("1 = Clinically significant, 0 = Normal range\n")
```

## Wide Format Transformation and Sample Filtering

```{r}
# Convert to wide format
cbcl_wide_bin <- cbcl_long_bin %>%
  dplyr::select(subjectkey, time, dplyr::all_of(symptom_vars_t)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = time,
    values_from = dplyr::all_of(symptom_vars_t),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{time}"
  )

# Filter: sufficient non-missing symptom data corresponding to at least 3 longitudinal assessment waves
# Each time point has 8 symptoms, so >= 24 non-missing values
cbcl_wide_k3 <- cbcl_wide_bin %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    non_missing_count = rowSums(!is.na(dplyr::across(-subjectkey)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(non_missing_count >= 3L * length(symptom_vars_t)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-non_missing_count) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rowid = dplyr::row_number())

cat("Sample size after filtering:", nrow(cbcl_wide_k3), "\n")
cat("Inclusion criterion: >= 3 time points with complete symptom data\n")
```

```{r}
fmt_n_pct <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  tab <- table(x)
  tibble::tibble(
    Level = names(tab),
    Overall = sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", as.integer(tab), 100 * as.integer(tab) / n)
  )
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x), sd(x))
}

tab1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(Variable = "Age (baseline), mean (SD)", Level = "", Overall = fmt_mean_sd(demo_full$ab_p_demo_age)),

  fmt_n_pct(demo_full$sex) %>% dplyr::mutate(Variable = "Sex") %>% dplyr::relocate(Variable),
  fmt_n_pct(demo_full$ethn_child) %>% dplyr::mutate(Variable = "Ethnicity (child)") %>% dplyr::relocate(Variable),
  fmt_n_pct(demo_full$race_cat) %>% dplyr::mutate(Variable = "Race (child)") %>% dplyr::relocate(Variable),
  fmt_n_pct(demo_full$income_cat) %>% dplyr::mutate(Variable = "Household income") %>% dplyr::relocate(Variable),
  fmt_n_pct(demo_full$edu_cat) %>% dplyr::mutate(Variable = "Parental education (self)") %>% dplyr::relocate(Variable)
)

tab1 <- tab1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variable) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Variable = ifelse(dplyr::row_number() == 1, Variable, "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

N <- dplyr::n_distinct(demo_full$subjectkey)
```

```{r}
  cols_tp <- paste0(symptom_vars_t, "_", tp)
```

# SLCA Model for K = 3

## Model Specification

```{r}
# Dynamically generate formulas for 6 time points (L1-L6)
base_var <- symptom_vars_t[1]

anx_cols <- grep(
  paste0("^", base_var, "_"),
  names(cbcl_wide_k3),
  value = TRUE
)

time_suffixes <- sub(paste0("^", base_var, "_"), "", anx_cols)
cat("Time suffixes:", time_suffixes, "\n")

L_names <- paste0("L", seq_along(time_suffixes))  # L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6
K <- 3  # Number of latent classes

cat("Latent variables:", L_names, "\n")
cat("Number of classes (K):", K, "\n")

# Function to create measurement model formula
make_lv_formula <- function(L, k, time_suffix, symptoms) {
  rhs <- paste0(symptoms, "_", time_suffix, collapse = " + ")
  as.formula(paste0(L, "[", k, "] ~ ", rhs))
}

# Create measurement formulas for each time point
meas_forms_k3 <- Map(
  function(L, t) make_lv_formula(L, K, t, symptom_vars_t),
  L_names, time_suffixes
)

# Create transition formulas (first-order Markov chain)
trans_forms <- lapply(
  seq_len(length(L_names) - 1),
  function(i) as.formula(paste0(L_names[i], " ~ ", L_names[i + 1]))
)

# Combine all formulas
formulas_k3 <- c(meas_forms_k3, trans_forms)

# Display formulas
cat("\nMeasurement formulas:\n")
for (f in meas_forms_k3) print(f)
cat("\nTransition formulas:\n")
for (f in trans_forms) print(f)
```

# Parameter Extraction

## Extract Transition Probabilities (tau)
```{r}
params  <- param(fit_k3)
tau_obj <- params$tau

tidy_tau_raw <- NULL

if (is.list(tau_obj)) {
  tidy_tau_raw <- purrr::imap_dfr(tau_obj, function(M, edge){
    as_tibble(M, rownames = "child") |>
      pivot_longer(-child, names_to = "parent", values_to = "value_raw") |>
      mutate(edge = edge)
  })
} else if (is.array(tau_obj) && length(dim(tau_obj)) == 3) {
  kmax <- dim(tau_obj)[3]
  tidy_tau_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(1:kmax, function(k){
    as_tibble(tau_obj[,,k], rownames = "child") |>
      pivot_longer(-child, names_to = "parent", values_to = "value_raw") |>
      mutate(edge = paste0("edge_", k))
  })
} else if (is.matrix(tau_obj)) {
  tidy_tau_raw <- as_tibble(tau_obj, rownames = "child") |>
    pivot_longer(-child, names_to = "parent", values_to = "value_raw") |>
    mutate(edge = "common")
} else {
  stop("Unknown tau object structure.")
}

tidy_tau_raw <- tidy_tau_raw %>%
  mutate(
    child  = as.integer(child),
    parent = as.integer(parent)
  ) %>%
  # normalize by parent (columns)
  group_by(edge, parent) %>%
  mutate(prob = value_raw / sum(value_raw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Extract Response Probabilities (rho)

```{r}
rho_list <- params$rho
```

```{r}
extract_rho_df_fixed <- function(rho_mat, time_name) {
  long_df <- as.data.frame(rho_mat)
  colnames(long_df) <- colnames(rho_mat)

  raw_vars <- attr(rho_mat, "vars")
  if (is.list(raw_vars)) {
    symptom_codes <- unlist(raw_vars, use.names = FALSE)
  } else {
    symptom_codes <- raw_vars
  }

  J <- length(symptom_codes)

  response <- rep(c(1, 2), times = J)
  symptom  <- rep(symptom_codes, each = 2)

  long_df$Response <- response
  long_df$Symptom_Code <- symptom
  long_df$Time_code <- time_name

  df_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
    long_df,
    cols = colnames(rho_mat),
    names_to = "Class",
    values_to = "Probability"
  )

  return(df_long)
}

rho_df_all <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  rho_list,
  names(rho_list),
  extract_rho_df_fixed
)
```

# Class Labeling (Baseline Prototype Matching)

```{r}
# Function to get symptom profile (prototype) for each class at a time point
get_proto <- function(df, time_code) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Time_code == time_code,
                  Response == 2) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Class, Symptom) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(p = mean(Probability), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Symptom, values_from = p) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(as.integer(Class)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Class") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    { .[, order(colnames(.)), drop = FALSE] }
}
```

```{r}
# Get time codes from rho_list and filter to only expected 6 time points
time_codes_raw <- names(rho_list)
cat("Raw time codes from rho_list:", time_codes_raw, "\n")
cat("Number of time codes:", length(time_codes_raw), "\n")

# Only keep the first 6 time points (L1-L6)
time_codes <- time_codes_raw[1:min(6, length(time_codes_raw))]
cat("Filtered time codes:", time_codes, "\n")

baseline_code <- time_codes[1]

# Get baseline prototype and order by severity
P_baseline <- get_proto(rho_df_all, baseline_code)

ord_base <- order(rowMeans(P_baseline, na.rm = TRUE))
baseline_class_ids <- as.integer(rownames(P_baseline)[ord_base])

baseline_proto <- P_baseline[ord_base, , drop = FALSE]

stable_labels <- c("Low symptom group", "Moderate symptoms", "High symptom group")

map_baseline <- tibble::tibble(
  Time_code = baseline_code,
  Class = baseline_class_ids,
  Label = factor(stable_labels[seq_along(baseline_class_ids)],
                     levels = stable_labels)
)

cat("Baseline class ordering (by mean symptom probability):\n")
print(map_baseline)
```

```{r}
# Match other time points to baseline prototype using squared Euclidean distance
make_map_one <- function(df, time_code, baseline_proto, stable_labels) {
  if (time_code == baseline_code) {
    return(map_baseline)
  }

  P_t <- get_proto(df, time_code)

  # Ensure column alignment between baseline_proto and P_t
  common_cols <- intersect(colnames(baseline_proto), colnames(P_t))
  if (length(common_cols) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No common columns for time_code:", time_code))
    return(NULL)
  }

  baseline_aligned <- baseline_proto[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  P_t_aligned <- P_t[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

  perms <- list(c(1,2,3), c(1,3,2), c(2,1,3), c(2,3,1), c(3,1,2), c(3,2,1))
  best_cost <- Inf; best_perm <- NULL

  for (perm in perms) {
    P_t_perm <- P_t_aligned[as.character(perm), , drop = FALSE]
    cost <- sum((baseline_aligned - P_t_perm)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (cost < best_cost) {
      best_cost <- cost
      best_perm <- perm
    }
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    Time_code = time_code,
    Class = as.integer(best_perm),
    Label = factor(stable_labels, levels = stable_labels)
  )
}

map_all <- purrr::map_dfr(
  time_codes,
```

```{r}
posterior_prob_list <- fit_k3$posterior

get_map <- function(prob_mat) {
  if (is.null(prob_mat)) stop("prob_mat is NULL")
  max.col(prob_mat, ties.method = "first")
}

# Get latent variable names and filter to first 6 (L1-L6)

n_data <- nrow(cbcl_wide_k3)
cat("Posterior matrix rows:", n_posterior, "\n")
cat("Data rows:", n_data, "\n")

# Ensure posterior probabilities align with the current analysis dataset
if (n_posterior != n_data) {
  stop(
    sprintf(
      "Row count mismatch: posterior has %d rows, but cbcl_wide_k3 has %d rows. Check whether fit_k3 was estimated using the same cbcl_wide_k3 dataset.",
      n_posterior,
      n_data
    )
  )
}

posterior_k3_df <- cbcl_wide_k3 %>%

for (lv in lv_names) {
```

```{r}
# 6 time points, need exactly 5 transitions (edges)
time_labels <- c("Baseline", "1-year", "2-year", "3-year", "4-year", "5-year")
time_map <- tibble::tibble(
  Time_code  = time_codes[1:6],
  Time_label = time_labels[1:length(time_codes)]
)

cat("Time codes:", time_codes, "\n")
cat("Time labels:", time_labels[1:length(time_codes)], "\n")

# Get edge levels and filter to only first 5 (for 6 time points)
edge_levels_raw <- unique(tidy_tau_raw$edge)
cat("Raw edge levels:", edge_levels_raw, "\n")

# Only keep first 5 edges (Baseline->1y, 1y->2y, 2y->3y, 3y->4y, 4y->5y)
n_edges_needed <- length(time_codes) - 1
edge_levels <- edge_levels_raw[1:min(n_edges_needed, length(edge_levels_raw))]
cat("Filtered edge levels:", edge_levels, "\n")

# Filter tidy_tau_raw to only include needed edges
tidy_tau_raw <- tidy_tau_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge %in% edge_levels)

edge_time_map <- tibble::tibble(
  edge = edge_levels,
  from_code = time_codes[1:length(edge_levels)],
  to_code = time_codes[2:(length(edge_levels) + 1)]
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map %>% dplyr::rename(from_code = Time_code, from_lab = Time_label),
    by = "from_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map %>% dplyr::rename(to_code = Time_code, to_lab = Time_label),
    by = "to_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_label = paste(from_lab, "->", to_lab),
    edge_label = dplyr::if_else(edge == "common",
                                "Common (invariant)",
                                edge_label)
  )

cat("\nEdge time mapping:\n")
print(edge_time_map)
```

```{r}
## Create a stable numeric id: Low=1, Moderate=2, High=3 for each time point
```

```{r}
norm_edge <- function(s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "\u00A0", " ")
  s <- str_squish(s)
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "→", "->")
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "\\s*->\\s*", " -> ")
  s
}

to_short_class <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(x, regex("low", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Low",
    str_detect(x, regex("moderate|mod", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Moderate",
    str_detect(x, regex("high", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# triangle layout
node_pos <- tibble(
  name = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"),
  x    = c(0, 1, 2),
  y    = c(0, 1.7, 0)
)

tau_plot_df <- tidy_tau_aligned %>%
  mutate(
    edge_label_raw  = as.character(edge_label),
    edge_label_norm = norm_edge(edge_label_raw),
    from = to_short_class(child_label),
    to   = to_short_class(parent_label),
    prob = as.numeric(prob)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(from), !is.na(to), !is.na(prob)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = factor(from, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High")),
    to   = factor(to,   levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))
  )

plot_state_diagram <- function(df_tau, edge_label, digits = 2) {

  edge_in_norm <- norm_edge(edge_label)

  df_e <- df_tau %>%
    dplyr::filter(edge_label_norm == edge_in_norm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lab = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), prob),
      is_self = (as.character(from) == as.character(to))
    )

  if (nrow(df_e) == 0) {
    stop("No rows matched this edge_label: ", edge_label,
         "\nValid edges: ", paste(sort(unique(df_tau$edge_label_norm)), collapse = " | "))
  }

  vertices <- node_pos %>% dplyr::mutate(label = name)

  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = df_e %>% dplyr::select(from, to, prob, lab, is_self),
    directed = TRUE,
    vertices = vertices
  )

  off_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
    ~from,  ~to,  ~dx,  ~dy,
    "Low", "Moderate", -0.10, 0.06,
    "Moderate", "Low", 0.10, -0.06,

    "Moderate", "High", 0.10, 0.06,
    "High", "Moderate", -0.10, -0.06,

    "Low", "High", 0.00, -0.10,
    "High", "Low", 0.00, 0.10,

    # self-loops
    "Low", "Low", -0.22, 0.20,
    "Moderate", "Moderate", 0.00, 0.42,
    "High", "High", 0.22, 0.20
  )

  edge_mid <- df_e %>%
    dplyr::left_join(vertices, by = c("from" = "name")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(vertices, by = c("to" = "name")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(x_to = x, y_to = y) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      x0 = (x_from + x_to) / 2,
      y0 = (y_from + y_to) / 2
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(off_tbl, by = c("from", "to")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dx = dplyr::coalesce(dx, 0),
      dy = dplyr::coalesce(dy, 0),
      x_mid = x0 + dx,
      y_mid = y0 + dy
    )

  edge_title <- df_e %>%
    dplyr::distinct(edge_label_raw) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::pull(edge_label_raw)

  ggraph::ggraph(g, layout = "manual", x = igraph::V(g)$x, y = igraph::V(g)$y) +
    ggraph::geom_edge_fan(
      aes(filter = !is_self),
      arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", length = grid::unit(3.0, "mm")),
      start_cap = ggraph::circle(8, "mm"),
      end_cap = ggraph::circle(8, "mm"),
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggraph::geom_edge_loop(
      aes(filter = is_self),
      arrow = grid::arrow(type = "closed", length = grid::unit(3.0, "mm")),
      start_cap = ggraph::circle(8, "mm"),
      end_cap = ggraph::circle(8, "mm"),
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # nodes
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = vertices,
      aes(x, y),
      shape = 21, size = 14, stroke = 1.2,
      fill = "white", colour = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = vertices,
      aes(x, y, label = label),
      size = 5.5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    # labels LAST
    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = edge_mid,
      aes(x = x_mid, y = y_mid, label = lab),
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0,
      size = 4
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal(expand = TRUE, clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("State Transition Diagram (Model-estimated): "),
      subtitle = edge_title
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = grid::unit(c(12, 30, 12, 30), "pt")
    )
}
```

# Empirical Transition Proportions

```{r}
make_trans <- function(df, from, to) {
  f_sym <- rlang::sym(from)
  t_sym <- rlang::sym(to)

  lv_f <- levels(df[[from]])
  lv_t <- levels(df[[to]])

  df %>%
    dplyr::count(!!f_sym, !!t_sym, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      !!f_sym := factor(lv_f, levels = lv_f),
      !!t_sym := factor(lv_t, levels = lv_t),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      from_class = !!f_sym,
      to_class   = !!t_sym
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(from_class) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tot = sum(n),
      p = ifelse(tot > 0, n / tot, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-tot) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

lv_pairs <- tibble::tibble(
  from_lv = lv_names[-length(lv_names)],
  to_lv   = lv_names[-1],
  from_code = time_codes[-length(time_codes)],
  to_code   = time_codes[-1]
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map %>% dplyr::rename(from_code = Time_code, from_lab = Time_label),
    by = "from_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map %>% dplyr::rename(to_code = Time_code, to_lab = Time_label),
    by = "to_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_label = paste(from_lab, "->", to_lab)
  )
```

```{r}
      (L3 != "Missing" & L4 != "Missing" & L3 != L4) |
      (L4 != "Missing" & L5 != "Missing" & L4 != L5) |
      (L5 != "Missing" & L6 != "Missing" & L5 != L6)
  )

n_total <- nrow(change_df)
n_change_observed <- sum(change_df$any_change, na.rm = TRUE)
prop_change_observed <- round(100 * n_change_observed / n_total, 1)

cat("Total sample:", n_total, "\n")
cat("Observed changers:", prop_change_observed, "(", prop_change_observed, "%)\n")
cat("No observed adjacent class change:", n_total - n_change_observed, "(", 100 - prop_change_observed, "%)\n")
```

# Trajectory Classification

```{r}
# Define severity ranking
rank_map <- c(
  "Low symptom group" = 1,
  "Moderate symptoms" = 2,
  "High symptom group" = 3
)

traj_base <- posterior_k3_df_labeled %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subjectkey,
    L1 = forcats::fct_relevel(L1, stable_labels),
    L2 = forcats::fct_relevel(L2, stable_labels),
    L3 = forcats::fct_relevel(L3, stable_labels),
    L4 = forcats::fct_relevel(L4, stable_labels),
    L5 = forcats::fct_relevel(L5, stable_labels),
    L6 = forcats::fct_relevel(L6, stable_labels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    L1n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L1)]),
    L2n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L2)]),
    L3n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L3)]),
    L4n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L4)]),
    L5n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L5)]),
    L6n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L6)])
  )
```

```{r}
# Classification Rules:
# Stable: No change throughout all time points
# Improved: End point < Start point AND no upward movement
# Worsened: End point > Start point AND no downward movement
# Fluctuate: Other cases (mixture of up and down movements)

classify_path <- function(x) {
  d <- diff(x)
  up <- any(d > 0)
  dn <- any(d < 0)
  start <- x[1]
  end <- x[length(x)]

  if (all(d == 0)) {
    "Stable"
  } else if (end < start && !up) {
    "Improved"
  } else if (end > start && !dn) {
    "Worsened"
  } else {
    "Fluctuate"
  }
}
```

```{r}
traj_type_df <- traj_base %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TrajectoryType = classify_path(c(L1n, L2n, L3n, L4n, L5n, L6n))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(subjectkey, TrajectoryType)
```

## Empirical transition by sex

```{r}
make_trans_by <- function(df, from, to, by) {
  f <- rlang::ensym(from); t <- rlang::ensym(to); b <- rlang::ensym(by)

  lv_f <- levels(df[[rlang::as_name(f)]])
  lv_t <- levels(df[[rlang::as_name(t)]])

  df %>%
    dplyr::count(!!b, !!f, !!t, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      !!b,
      !!f := factor(lv_f, levels = lv_f),
      !!t := factor(lv_t, levels = lv_t),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!b, !!f) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tot = sum(n),
      p   = ifelse(tot > 0, n / tot, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-tot) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}
```

```{r}
T_all_sex <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  lv_pairs,
  function(from_lv, to_lv, from_code, to_code, from_lab, to_lab, edge_label) {

    make_trans_by(posterior_k3_df_labeled_sex, !!from_lv, !!to_lv, sex) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        sex = as.character(sex),
        edge_label = edge_label,
        from = as.character(.data[[from_lv]]),
        to   = as.character(.data[[to_lv]]),
        prob = p
      )
  }
)
```

```{r}
emp_by_sex <- T_all_sex %>%
```

```{r}
# extract ASR syndrome scores by wave
extract_asr_wave <- function(asr_data, session, suffix) {
  asr_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(session_id == session) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      subjectkey = participant_id,
      !!paste0("asr_anxdep_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__anxdep_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_withdr_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__wthdr_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_somatic_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__som_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_thought_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__tho_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_attention_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__attn_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_rulebreak_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__rule_sum),
      !!paste0("asr_aggressive_", suffix) :=
        as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__aggr_sum)
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_cor_safe <- function(Time, Domain, child, parent) {
  dat <- pc_master_df %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(child, parent))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

  if (
    nrow(dat) < 5 ||
    stats::sd(dat[[child]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ||
    stats::sd(dat[[parent]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        Time = Time,
        Domain = Domain,
        N = nrow(dat),
        r = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  ct <- stats::cor.test(
    dat[[child]],
    dat[[parent]],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    Time = Time,
    Domain = Domain,
    N = nrow(dat),
    r = round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
    p = signif(ct$p.value, 3)
  )
}

corr_feasibility_all <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  matched_pairs_long,
  run_cor_safe
)

knitr::kable(
  corr_feasibility_all,
  caption = "Parent-child symptom correlations across baseline, 2-year, and 4-year assessments"
)
```

## By sex

```{r}
pc_master_df <- pc_master_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sex_map, by = "subjectkey")

run_cor_by_sex_safe <- function(Time, Domain, child, parent) {
  purrr::map_dfr(c("Male", "Female"), function(sex_level) {

    dat <- pc_master_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(sex == sex_level) %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(child, parent))) %>%
      dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

    if (
      nrow(dat) < 5 ||
      stats::sd(dat[[child]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ||
      stats::sd(dat[[parent]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0
    ) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble(
          Time = Time,
          Sex = sex_level,
          Domain = Domain,
          N = nrow(dat),
          r = NA_real_,
          p = NA_real_
        )
      )
    }

    ct <- stats::cor.test(
      dat[[child]],
      dat[[parent]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    tibble::tibble(
      Time = Time,
      Sex = sex_level,
      Domain = Domain,
      N = nrow(dat),
      r = round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
      p = signif(ct$p.value, 3)
    )
  })
}

corr_feasibility_sex_all <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  matched_pairs_long,
  run_cor_by_sex_safe
)

knitr::kable(

)
```

### caregiver information

```{r}
sessions_keep <- c("ses-00A", "ses-02A", "ses-04A")

caregiver_baseline <- demo_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(session_id == "ses-00A") %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, ab_p_demo__relation_001) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(participant_id)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    relation_code = readr::parse_integer(as.character(ab_p_demo__relation_001)),
    caregiver_label = dplyr::case_when(
      relation_code == 1 ~ "Biological mother",
      relation_code == 2 ~ "Biological father",
      relation_code == 3 ~ "Adoptive parent",
      relation_code == 4 ~ "Custodial parent",
      relation_code == 5 ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
caregiver_summary <- caregiver_baseline %>%
  dplyr::count(caregiver_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n))

knitr::kable(
  caregiver_summary,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Baseline caregiver relationship distribution"
)
```

Caregiver relationship was derived from the baseline demographic variable (ab_p_demo__relation_001), which had no missingness at ses-00A.

The visit-level informant variables were not used as the primary source because they were introduced partway through baseline data collection and therefore showed substantial missingness at ses-00A.

Given that caregiver identity is expected to be relatively stable over time, baseline caregiver relationship was used as a proxy across follow-up waves.

## Build parent analytic sample for ASR cutoff

```{r}
# 1. Baseline caregiver relationship from demographic table
caregiver_baseline <- demo_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(session_id == "ses-00A") %>%
  dplyr::select(participant_id, ab_p_demo__relation_001) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(participant_id)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subjectkey = participant_id,
    relation_code = readr::parse_integer(as.character(ab_p_demo__relation_001)),
    caregiver_baseline = dplyr::case_when(
      relation_code == 1 ~ "Biological mother",
      relation_code == 2 ~ "Biological father",
      relation_code == 3 ~ "Adoptive parent",
      relation_code == 4 ~ "Custodial parent",
      relation_code == 5 ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# 2. Keep only baseline ASR observations
asr_base <- asr_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(session_id == "ses-00A") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subjectkey = participant_id,
    session_id,
    asr_anxdep = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__anxdep_sum),
    asr_withdr = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__wthdr_sum),
    asr_somatic = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__som_sum),
    asr_thought = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__tho_sum),
    asr_attention = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__attn_sum),
    asr_rulebreak = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__rule_sum),
    asr_aggressive = as.numeric(mh_p_asr__synd__aggr_sum)
  )

# 3. Add parent sex and age
parent_demo_base <- demo_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(session_id == "ses-00A") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    participant_id,
    ab_p_demo__age__slf_001
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subjectkey = participant_id,
    parent_age_baseline = as.numeric(ab_p_demo__age__slf_001)
  )

# 4. Merge together
parent_base_for_cutoff <- asr_base %>%
  dplyr::left_join(caregiver_baseline, by = "subjectkey") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(parent_demo_base, by = "subjectkey")

# 5. Restrict to biological parents only
parent_base_bio <- parent_base_for_cutoff %>%
  dplyr::filter(caregiver_baseline %in% c("Biological mother", "Biological father"))

parent_base_bio %>%
  dplyr::count(caregiver_baseline)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::mutate(
    parent_sex = dplyr::case_when(
      caregiver_baseline == "Biological mother" ~ "Female",
      caregiver_baseline == "Biological father" ~ "Male",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
age_cut <- median(parent_base_bio$parent_age_baseline, na.rm = TRUE)

parent_base_bio <- parent_base_bio %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    parent_age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      parent_age_baseline < age_cut ~ "Younger",
      parent_age_baseline >= age_cut ~ "Older",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    group4 = paste(parent_age_group, parent_sex, sep = "_")
  )

parent_base_bio %>%
  dplyr::count(group4)
```

```{r}
parent_t <- parent_base_bio

for (var in asr_vars) {

  # 1. calculate baseline mean & sd
  cutoff_stats <- parent_t %>%
    dplyr::group_by(group4) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_raw = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_raw = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 2. join and compute T-score
  parent_t <- parent_t %>%
    dplyr::left_join(cutoff_stats, by = "group4") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!paste0(var, "_t") :=
        50 + 10 * (.data[[var]] - mean_raw) / sd_raw,

      !!paste0(var, "_bin63") :=
        dplyr::if_else(
          .data[[paste0(var, "_t")]] >= 63,
          1L, 0L,
          missing = NA_integer_
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-mean_raw, -sd_raw)
}
```

```{r}
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    caregiver_status = {
      vals <- c(caregiver_00A, caregiver_02A, caregiver_04A)
      vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
      
      if (length(vals) == 0) {
        "Insufficient"
      } else if (length(unique(vals)) == 1) {
        "Stable"
      } else {
        "Changed"
      }
    },
    caregiver_stable = caregiver_status == "Stable"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

Across the three assessment waves included in the parent-child analyses, 92.5% (n = 10,376) of participants had a stable caregiver reporter, whereas 7.5% (n = 846) experienced at least one caregiver change across study waves.

```{r}

  dplyr::filter(caregiver_status == "Stable") %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)

  dplyr::filter(caregiver_status == "Stable") %>%

  dplyr::filter(caregiver_status == "Changed") %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)

pct_changed <- caregiver_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(caregiver_status == "Changed") %>%
  dplyr::pull(percent)
```

Caregiver stability was defined as identical caregiver identity across all available visits. Missing follow-up caregiver information was treated as non-informative for caregiver change.

```{r}
parent_long <- asr_raw %>%
```

```{r}
    parent_ext_mean = mean(parent_ext_00A, na.rm = TRUE),
    parent_ext_sd   = sd(parent_ext_00A, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Cross-lagged Model

### internalizing

```{r}
model_int <- '

# autoregressive paths

child_int_02A ~ child_int_00A
child_int_04A ~ child_int_02A

parent_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

# cross-lag paths

child_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
child_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

parent_int_02A ~ child_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ child_int_02A

# correlations

child_int_00A ~~ parent_int_00A
child_int_02A ~~ parent_int_02A
child_int_04A ~~ parent_int_04A

'
```

```{r}
fit_int <- lavaan::sem(
  model_int,
  data = analysis_data,
  missing = "fiml"
)
```

```{r}
summary(
  fit_int,
  standardized = TRUE,
  fit.measures = TRUE
)
```

Parent and child psychopathology show bidirectional longitudinal associations. Parent internalizing symptoms predicted increases in child internalizing symptoms over time, and child symptoms also predicted increases in parent symptoms.

### externalizing

```{r}
model_ext <- '

# autoregressive paths
child_ext_02A ~ child_ext_00A
child_ext_04A ~ child_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

# cross-lag paths
child_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
child_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ child_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ child_ext_02A

# within-wave correlations
child_ext_00A ~~ parent_ext_00A
child_ext_02A ~~ parent_ext_02A
child_ext_04A ~~ parent_ext_04A

'

fit_ext <- lavaan::sem(
  model_ext,
  data = analysis_data,
  missing = "fiml"
)

summary(
  fit_ext,
  standardized = TRUE,
  fit.measures = TRUE
)
```

Parent externalizing predicts child externalizing.
We observed bidirectional longitudinal associations between parent and child psychopathology for both internalizing and externalizing domains.The child-to-parent associations appeared stronger than parent-to-child associations.

### heterotypic 1

#### parent externalizing → child internalizing

```{r}
model_hetero_1 <- '

# autoregressive
child_int_02A ~ child_int_00A
child_int_04A ~ child_int_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

# cross-lag heterotypic
child_int_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
child_int_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ child_int_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ child_int_02A

# correlations
child_int_00A ~~ parent_ext_00A
child_int_02A ~~ parent_ext_02A
child_int_04A ~~ parent_ext_04A

'
```

```{r}
fit_hetero_1 <- lavaan::sem(
  model_hetero_1,
  data = analysis_data,
  missing = "fiml"
)

summary(
  fit_hetero_1,
  standardized = TRUE,
  fit.measures = TRUE
)
```

Parent externalizing symptoms predicted increases in child internalizing symptoms across time. These heterotypic associations were significant but modest in magnitude. Bidirectional effects were observed, although parent-to-child effects were slightly stronger than child-to-parent effects.

### heterotypic 2

#### parent internalizing → child externalizing

```{r}
model_hetero_2 <- '

# autoregressive
child_ext_02A ~ child_ext_00A
child_ext_04A ~ child_ext_02A

parent_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

# cross-lag heterotypic
child_ext_02A ~ parent_int_00A
child_ext_04A ~ parent_int_02A

parent_int_02A ~ child_ext_00A
parent_int_04A ~ child_ext_02A

# correlations
child_ext_00A ~~ parent_int_00A
child_ext_02A ~~ parent_int_02A
child_ext_04A ~~ parent_int_04A

'
```

```{r}
fit_hetero_2 <- lavaan::sem(
  model_hetero_2,
  data = analysis_data,
  missing = "fiml"
)

summary(
  fit_hetero_2,
  standardized = TRUE,
  fit.measures = TRUE
)
```

The heterotypic cross-lagged model revealed significant bidirectional associations between parent internalizing symptoms and child externalizing behaviors. Parent internalizing symptoms predicted increases in child externalizing symptoms from baseline to 2-year and from 2-year to 4-year follow-up. Child externalizing symptoms also predicted increases in parent internalizing symptoms, although these effects were smaller in magnitude. Overall, results suggest stronger parent-to-child heterotypic transmission.

### three-factor model for child internalizing

```{r}
model_3f_child_int_cov <- '

# autoregressive paths
child_int_02A ~ child_int_00A
child_int_04A ~ child_int_02A

parent_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

# cross-lag paths
child_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
child_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A + parent_ext_02A

parent_int_02A ~ child_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_04A ~ child_int_02A + parent_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ child_int_00A + parent_int_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ child_int_02A + parent_int_02A

# covariates (constrained equal across time)
child_int_02A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu
child_int_04A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu

parent_int_02A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu
parent_int_04A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu

parent_ext_02A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu
parent_ext_04A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu

# within-wave correlations
child_int_00A ~~ parent_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_00A ~~ parent_ext_00A

child_int_02A ~~ parent_int_02A + parent_ext_02A
parent_int_02A ~~ parent_ext_02A

child_int_04A ~~ parent_int_04A + parent_ext_04A
parent_int_04A ~~ parent_ext_04A
'
```

After adjusting for covariates, parent internalizing remained the strongest and most consistent predictor of child internalizing symptoms across time, whereas parent externalizing effects were substantially weaker. Child-to-parent effects were statistically significant but small in magnitude, suggesting a predominantly parent-driven association.

Among covariates, sex was significantly associated with child internalizing symptoms, with females showing slightly higher levels, while age and parental education were not significantly associated with either child or parent outcomes.

## Split-half validation

```{r}
n_iter <- 5000

split_half_int_path <- file.path(out_dir, "split_half_int_5000.rds")
split_half_ext_path <- file.path(out_dir, "split_half_ext_5000.rds")
split_half_int_summary_path <- file.path(out_dir, "split_half_int_summary_5000.rds")
split_half_ext_summary_path <- file.path(out_dir, "split_half_ext_summary_5000.rds")

get_crosslag_ext <- function(fit) {
  parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      op == "~",
      (
        lhs %in% c("child_ext_02A", "child_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
                     "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A")
      ) |
        (
          lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
                     "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("child_ext_00A", "child_ext_02A")
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(lhs, rhs) %>%
    dplyr::select(lhs, rhs, std.all)
}

get_crosslag_int <- function(fit) {
  parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      op == "~",
      (
        lhs %in% c("child_int_02A", "child_int_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
                     "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A")
      ) |
        (
          lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
                     "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("child_int_00A", "child_int_02A")
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(lhs, rhs) %>%
    dplyr::select(lhs, rhs, std.all)
}

run_one_split <- function(data, model, get_fun) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  group_A_id <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(n / 2), replace = FALSE)

  data_A <- data[group_A_id, ]
  data_B <- data[-group_A_id, ]

  fit_A <- tryCatch(
    lavaan::sem(model, data = data_A, missing = "fiml"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  fit_B <- tryCatch(
    lavaan::sem(model, data = data_B, missing = "fiml"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_A) | is.null(fit_B)) return(NA_real_)

  if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit_A, "converged") |
      !lavaan::lavInspect(fit_B, "converged")) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  est_A <- get_fun(fit_A)
  est_B <- get_fun(fit_B)

  est_joined <- est_A %>%
    dplyr::rename(std.all_A = std.all) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      est_B %>% dplyr::rename(std.all_B = std.all),
      by = c("lhs", "rhs")
    )

  if (nrow(est_joined) < 3) return(NA_real_)

  cor(
    est_joined$std.all_A,
    est_joined$std.all_B,
    use = "complete.obs",
    method = "pearson"
  )
}

summarize_split_half <- function(correlations, model_name, n_iter) {
  tibble::tibble(
    model = model_name,
    n_iter_requested = n_iter,
    n_iter_successful = sum(!is.na(correlations)),
    mean_correlation = mean(correlations, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_correlation = median(correlations, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_correlation = sd(correlations, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = as.numeric(quantile(correlations, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    q975 = as.numeric(quantile(correlations, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    min_correlation = min(correlations, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_correlation = max(correlations, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
cores <- parallel::detectCores()
cl <- parallel::makeCluster(cores - 1)

doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)
doRNG::registerDoRNG(123)

split_half_int <- foreach(
  i = seq_len(n_iter),
  .combine = c,
  .packages = c("lavaan", "dplyr"),
  .export = c("run_one_split", "get_crosslag_int")
) %dopar% {
  tryCatch(
    run_one_split(
      data = analysis_data,
      model = model_3f_child_int_cov,
      get_fun = get_crosslag_int
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

split_half_ext <- foreach(
  i = seq_len(n_iter),
  .combine = c,
  .packages = c("lavaan", "dplyr"),
  .export = c("run_one_split", "get_crosslag_ext")
) %dopar% {
  tryCatch(
    run_one_split(
      data = analysis_data,
      model = model_3f_child_ext_cov,
      get_fun = get_crosslag_ext
    ),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

parallel::stopCluster(cl)

split_half_int_summary <- summarize_split_half(
  split_half_int,
  "Child internalizing",
  n_iter
)

split_half_ext_summary <- summarize_split_half(
  split_half_ext,
  "Child externalizing",
  n_iter
)

saveRDS(split_half_int, split_half_int_path)
saveRDS(split_half_ext, split_half_ext_path)
saveRDS(split_half_int_summary, split_half_int_summary_path)
saveRDS(split_half_ext_summary, split_half_ext_summary_path)
```

Split-half validation for internalizing showed high consistency, with a mean Pearson correlation of 0.81 across 5000 iterations, indicating strong robustness of the cross-lagged effects.

Split-half validation for externalizing showed low and highly variable correlations (mean = 0.37), with correlations ranging from negative to moderately high values, indicating poor stability of the externalizing cross-lagged effects.

```{r}
fit_parent_model <- function(data, model) {
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lavaan::sem(
      model,
      data = data,
      missing = "fiml",
      se = "bootstrap",
      bootstrap = 1000
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "converged")) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fit
}
```

Most internalizing paths remained positive in both groups, although the effect sizes were typically smaller in the father subgroup. In contrast, the externalizing results appeared less stable, with several effects approaching zero or changing direction in the father subgroup. These findings are consistent with the split-half validation results, which suggested stronger reproducibility for the internalizing model and weaker stability for the externalizing model.

```{r}
## Parent-specific split-half validation

n_iter_parent <- 5000

parent_split_path <- file.path(out_dir, "split_parent_results_5000.rds")
parent_split_summary_path <- file.path(out_dir, "parent_split_summary_5000.rds")

run_one_split_parent <- function(data, model, get_fun) {
  
  n <- nrow(data)
  group_A_id <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(n / 2), replace = FALSE)
  
  data_A <- data[group_A_id, ]
  data_B <- data[-group_A_id, ]
  
  fit_A <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      lavaan::sem(
        model,
        data = data_A,
        missing = "fiml",
        em.h1.iter.max = 5000
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_B <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      lavaan::sem(
        model,
        data = data_B,
        missing = "fiml",
        em.h1.iter.max = 5000
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_A) | is.null(fit_B)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      lhs = character(),
      rhs = character(),
      std_A = numeric(),
      std_B = numeric(),
      same_direction = logical(),
      mean_abs_effect = numeric()
    ))
  }
  
  if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit_A, "converged") |
      !lavaan::lavInspect(fit_B, "converged")) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      lhs = character(),
      rhs = character(),
      std_A = numeric(),
      std_B = numeric(),
      same_direction = logical(),
      mean_abs_effect = numeric()
    ))
  }
  
  est_A <- get_fun(fit_A) %>%
    dplyr::rename(std_A = std.all)
  
  est_B <- get_fun(fit_B) %>%
    dplyr::rename(std_B = std.all)
  
  est_A %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(est_B, by = c("lhs", "rhs")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      same_direction = sign(std_A) == sign(std_B),
      mean_abs_effect = (abs(std_A) + abs(std_B)) / 2
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_split_parent_model_parallel <- function(data, model, get_fun, outcome, caregiver, n_iter = 1000) {
  
  foreach(
    i = seq_len(n_iter),
    .combine = dplyr::bind_rows,
    .packages = c("lavaan", "dplyr", "tibble"),
    .export = c(
      "run_one_split_parent",
      "get_crosslag_int",
      "get_crosslag_ext"
    )
  ) %dopar% {
    
    out <- tryCatch(
      run_one_split_parent(
        data = data,
        model = model,
        get_fun = get_fun
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        tibble::tibble(
          lhs = character(),
          rhs = character(),
          std_A = numeric(),
          std_B = numeric(),
          same_direction = logical(),
          mean_abs_effect = numeric()
        )
      }
    )
    
    out %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        iter = i,
        outcome = outcome,
        caregiver_group = caregiver
      )
  }
}
```

```{r}
summarize_parent_split <- function(split_parent_results) {
  split_parent_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(std_A), !is.na(std_B)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(outcome, caregiver_group, lhs, rhs) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_successful = dplyr::n(),
      mean_beta_split_A = mean(std_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_beta_split_B = mean(std_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_beta_average = mean((std_A + std_B) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_abs_effect = mean(mean_abs_effect, na.rm = TRUE),
      same_direction_rate = mean(same_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      reproducible = dplyr::case_when(
        same_direction_rate >= 0.80 ~ "Yes",
        same_direction_rate >= 0.60 ~ "Partial",
        TRUE ~ "No"
      ),
      pathway = paste(rhs, "→", lhs)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      pathway,
      rhs,
      lhs,
      n_successful,
      mean_beta_split_A,
      mean_beta_split_B,
      mean_beta_average,
      mean_abs_effect,
      same_direction_rate,
      reproducible
    )
}
```

```{r}
fit_parent_model <- function(data, model, min_n = 100) {
  
  if (nrow(data) < min_n) {
    message("Group sample size too small: N = ", nrow(data))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lavaan::sem(
      model,
      data = data,
      missing = "fiml"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Model error: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  
  if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "converged")) {
    message("Model did not converge.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fit
}

fit_by_group <- function(data, group_name, model, get_fun, outcome_name) {
  
  fit <- fit_parent_model(data = data, model = model)
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      group4 = group_name,
      lhs = NA_character_,
      rhs = NA_character_,
      std.all = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  get_fun(fit) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      group4 = group_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(outcome, group4, lhs, rhs, std.all)
}
```

Results from the stable caregiver sensitivity analysis were highly similar to the primary analyses for mother-child models. Some attenuation and variability were observed in father-child models, likely reflecting the smaller sample size after restricting to participants with stable caregiver reporters. Overall, the direction and pattern of findings remained largely consistent.

### Table 3

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )
}

format_beta_ci_p <- function(beta, ci_lower, ci_upper, p) {
  paste0(
    sprintf("%.3f", beta),
    " [",
    sprintf("%.3f", ci_lower),
    ", ",
    sprintf("%.3f", ci_upper),
    "], p = ",
    format_p(p)
  )
}

clean_path_label <- function(rhs, lhs) {
  path_raw <- paste(rhs, lhs, sep = " → ")
  
  dplyr::recode(
    path_raw,
    
    "parent_int_00A → child_int_02A" = "Parent internalizing baseline → Child internalizing 2-year",
    "parent_int_02A → child_int_04A" = "Parent internalizing 2-year → Child internalizing 4-year",
    "child_int_00A → parent_int_02A" = "Child internalizing baseline → Parent internalizing 2-year",
    "child_int_02A → parent_int_04A" = "Child internalizing 2-year → Parent internalizing 4-year",
    "parent_ext_00A → child_int_02A" = "Parent externalizing baseline → Child internalizing 2-year",
    "parent_ext_02A → child_int_04A" = "Parent externalizing 2-year → Child internalizing 4-year",
    "child_int_00A → parent_ext_02A" = "Child internalizing baseline → Parent externalizing 2-year",
    "child_int_02A → parent_ext_04A" = "Child internalizing 2-year → Parent externalizing 4-year",
    
    "parent_int_00A → child_ext_02A" = "Parent internalizing baseline → Child externalizing 2-year",
    "parent_int_02A → child_ext_04A" = "Parent internalizing 2-year → Child externalizing 4-year",
    "child_ext_00A → parent_int_02A" = "Child externalizing baseline → Parent internalizing 2-year",
    "child_ext_02A → parent_int_04A" = "Child externalizing 2-year → Parent internalizing 4-year",
    "parent_ext_00A → child_ext_02A" = "Parent externalizing baseline → Child externalizing 2-year",
    "parent_ext_02A → child_ext_04A" = "Parent externalizing 2-year → Child externalizing 4-year",
    "child_ext_00A → parent_ext_02A" = "Child externalizing baseline → Parent externalizing 2-year",
    "child_ext_02A → parent_ext_04A" = "Child externalizing 2-year → Parent externalizing 4-year",
    
    .default = path_raw
  )
}

extract_clpm_table <- function(fit, outcome, sample, child_var) {
  
  standardizedSolution(fit, ci = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(op == "~") %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      (
        lhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_02A"), paste0(child_var, "_04A")) &
          rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
                     "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A")
      ) |
        (
          lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
                     "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_00A"), paste0(child_var, "_02A"))
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Sample = sample,
      Pathway = clean_path_label(rhs, lhs),
      pathway_raw = paste(rhs, "→", lhs),
      beta = est.std,
      ci_lower = ci.lower,
      ci_upper = ci.upper,
      pvalue = pvalue,
      beta_ci_p = format_beta_ci_p(beta, ci_lower, ci_upper, pvalue)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Outcome, Sample, Pathway, pathway_raw,
      rhs, lhs, beta, ci_lower, ci_upper, pvalue, beta_ci_p
    )
}
```

### Figure 2

```{r}
# Figure 2A data: overall CLPM network edges

format_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )
}

extract_fig2a_edges_full <- function(fit, outcome_model, child_var, child_label) {
  
  standardizedSolution(fit, ci = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(op == "~") %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      # Autoregressive paths
      (
        lhs %in% c(
          paste0(child_var, "_02A"), paste0(child_var, "_04A"),
          "parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
          "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A"
        ) &
          rhs %in% c(
            paste0(child_var, "_00A"), paste0(child_var, "_02A"),
            "parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
            "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A"
          ) &
          (
            # same-domain autoregressive
            (grepl("^child_", lhs) & grepl("^child_", rhs)) |
              (lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A") &
                 rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A")) |
              (lhs %in% c("parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
                 rhs %in% c("parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A"))
          )
      ) |
        # Cross-lagged parent -> child
        (
          lhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_02A"), paste0(child_var, "_04A")) &
            rhs %in% c(
              "parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
              "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A"
            )
        ) |
        # Cross-lagged child -> parent
        (
          lhs %in% c(
            "parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
            "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A"
          ) &
            rhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_00A"), paste0(child_var, "_02A"))
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome_model = outcome_model,
      beta = est.std,
      p_label = format_p(pvalue),
      significant = pvalue < 0.05,
      
      edge_type = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^child_", lhs) & grepl("^child_", rhs) ~ "Autoregressive",
        lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A") ~ "Autoregressive",
        lhs %in% c("parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A") ~ "Autoregressive",
        grepl("^parent_", rhs) & grepl("^child_", lhs) ~ "Cross-lagged parent -> child",
        grepl("^child_", rhs) & grepl("^parent_", lhs) ~ "Cross-lagged child -> parent",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        edge_type == "Autoregressive" ~ "Autoregressive",
        grepl("^parent_", rhs) & grepl("^child_", lhs) ~ "Parent -> Child",
        grepl("^child_", rhs) & grepl("^parent_", lhs) ~ "Child -> Parent",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      
      domain = dplyr::case_when(
        edge_type == "Autoregressive" & grepl("^child_", lhs) ~ paste0(child_label, " autoregressive"),
        edge_type == "Autoregressive" & grepl("parent_int", lhs) ~ "Parent INT autoregressive",
        edge_type == "Autoregressive" & grepl("parent_ext", lhs) ~ "Parent EXT autoregressive",
        grepl("_int_", rhs) & grepl("_int_", lhs) ~ "INT -> INT",
        grepl("_ext_", rhs) & grepl("_ext_", lhs) ~ "EXT -> EXT",
        grepl("_int_", rhs) & grepl("_ext_", lhs) ~ "INT -> EXT",
        grepl("_ext_", rhs) & grepl("_int_", lhs) ~ "EXT -> INT",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      
      from_node = dplyr::case_when(
        rhs == "child_int_00A" ~ "Child INT baseline",
        rhs == "child_int_02A" ~ "Child INT 2-year",
        rhs == "child_ext_00A" ~ "Child EXT baseline",
        rhs == "child_ext_02A" ~ "Child EXT 2-year",
        rhs == "parent_int_00A" ~ "Parent INT baseline",
        rhs == "parent_int_02A" ~ "Parent INT 2-year",
        rhs == "parent_ext_00A" ~ "Parent EXT baseline",
        rhs == "parent_ext_02A" ~ "Parent EXT 2-year",
        TRUE ~ rhs
      ),
      
      to_node = dplyr::case_when(
        lhs == "child_int_02A" ~ "Child INT 2-year",
        lhs == "child_int_04A" ~ "Child INT 4-year",
        lhs == "child_ext_02A" ~ "Child EXT 2-year",
        lhs == "child_ext_04A" ~ "Child EXT 4-year",
        lhs == "parent_int_02A" ~ "Parent INT 2-year",
        lhs == "parent_int_04A" ~ "Parent INT 4-year",
        lhs == "parent_ext_02A" ~ "Parent EXT 2-year",
        lhs == "parent_ext_04A" ~ "Parent EXT 4-year",
        TRUE ~ lhs
      ),
      
      edge_label = paste0(
        sprintf("%.2f", beta),
        ifelse(significant, "*", "")
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      outcome_model,
      edge_type,
      domain,
      direction,
      from_node,
      to_node,
      beta,
      p_label,
      significant,
      edge_label
    )
}
```

```{r}
extract_figure3_full_paths <- function(fit, outcome, caregiver, child_var) {
  
  standardizedSolution(fit, ci = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(op == "~") %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      # Autoregressive paths
      (
        lhs %in% c(
          paste0(child_var, "_02A"), paste0(child_var, "_04A"),
          "parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
          "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A"
        ) &
          rhs %in% c(
            paste0(child_var, "_00A"), paste0(child_var, "_02A"),
            "parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
            "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A"
          ) &
          (
            (grepl("^child_", lhs) & grepl("^child_", rhs)) |
              (lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A") &
                 rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A")) |
              (lhs %in% c("parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
                 rhs %in% c("parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A"))
          )
      ) |
        
        # Parent -> Child
        (
          lhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_02A"), paste0(child_var, "_04A")) &
            rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A",
                       "parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A")
        ) |
        
        # Child -> Parent
        (
          lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A",
                     "parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
            rhs %in% c(paste0(child_var, "_00A"), paste0(child_var, "_02A"))
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome = outcome,
      caregiver_group = caregiver,
      std.all = est.std,
      sig = dplyr::case_when(
        pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pvalue < 0.01  ~ "**",
        pvalue < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", std.all), sig),
      pathway = paste(rhs, "—>", lhs),
      edge_type = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("^child_", lhs) & grepl("^child_", rhs) ~ "Autoregressive",
        lhs %in% c("parent_int_02A", "parent_int_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_int_00A", "parent_int_02A") ~ "Autoregressive",
        lhs %in% c("parent_ext_02A", "parent_ext_04A") &
          rhs %in% c("parent_ext_00A", "parent_ext_02A") ~ "Autoregressive",
        grepl("^parent_", rhs) & grepl("^child_", lhs) ~ "Parent -> Child",
        grepl("^child_", rhs) & grepl("^parent_", lhs) ~ "Child -> Parent",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      arrow_color = dplyr::case_when(
        edge_type == "Autoregressive" ~ "black",
        edge_type == "Parent -> Child" ~ "red",
        edge_type == "Child -> Parent" ~ "blue",
        TRUE ~ "grey"
      ),
      line_type = dplyr::if_else(pvalue < 0.05, "solid", "dashed")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      edge_type,
      arrow_color,
      line_type,
      lhs,
      rhs,
      pathway,
      std.all,
      pvalue,
      label
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_cor_by_dyad_safe <- function(Time, Domain, child, parent) {
  purrr::map_dfr(
    c("Mother-Daughter", "Mother-Son", "Father-Daughter", "Father-Son"),
    function(dyad_level) {

      dat <- pc_master_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(DyadGroup == dyad_level) %>%
        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(child, parent))) %>%
        dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(.))

      if (
        nrow(dat) < 5 ||
        stats::sd(dat[[child]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 ||
        stats::sd(dat[[parent]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0
      ) {
        return(
          tibble::tibble(
            Time = Time,
            DyadGroup = dyad_level,
            Domain = Domain,
            N = nrow(dat),
            r = NA_real_,
            p = NA_real_
          )
        )
      }

      ct <- stats::cor.test(
        dat[[child]],
        dat[[parent]],
        method = "pearson"
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        Time = Time,
        DyadGroup = dyad_level,
        Domain = Domain,
        N = nrow(dat),
        r = round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
        p = signif(ct$p.value, 3)
      )
    }
  )
}

corr_dyad_all <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  matched_pairs_long,
  run_cor_by_dyad_safe
)
```

```{r}
corr_dyad_all <- corr_dyad_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    r = as.numeric(r),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("Baseline", "2-year", "4-year")),
    DyadGroup = factor(
      DyadGroup,
      levels = c(
        "Mother-Daughter",
        "Mother-Son",
        "Father-Daughter",
        "Father-Son"
      )
    ),
    z = atanh(r),
    se_z = 1 / sqrt(N - 3),
    z_lo = z - 1.96 * se_z,
    z_hi = z + 1.96 * se_z,
    r_lo = tanh(z_lo),
    r_hi = tanh(z_hi)
  )

p_dyad_facet <- ggplot(
  corr_dyad_all,
  aes(x = Time, y = r, group = DyadGroup, color = DyadGroup)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = r_lo, ymax = r_hi), width = 0.08) +
  facet_wrap(~Domain, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pearson correlation (r): CBCL (child) vs ASR (parent)",
    color = "Parent-child dyad",
    title = "Parent–child correlations across time by parent-child dyad"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# IPW sensitivity analysis: mother vs father sample

```{r}
# Build IPW dataset
ipw_check_data <- analysis_data_mf %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    demo_full %>%
      dplyr::select(
        subjectkey,
        race_cat,
        ethn_child,
        income_cat,
        edu_cat
      ),
    by = "subjectkey"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    caregiver_group = factor(caregiver_group, levels = c("mother", "father")),
    father_sample = ifelse(caregiver_group == "father", 1, 0),
    sex = factor(sex),
    race_cat = factor(race_cat),
    ethn_child = factor(ethn_child),
    income_cat = factor(income_cat),
    edu_cat = factor(edu_cat),
    age_bl = as.numeric(age_bl),
    parent_edu = as.numeric(parent_edu)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(caregiver_group),
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(age_bl),
    !is.na(race_cat),
    !is.na(ethn_child),
    !is.na(income_cat),
    !is.na(edu_cat)
  )

table(ipw_check_data$caregiver_group)

# Estimate propensity scores
ipw_model <- glm(
  father_sample ~ sex + age_bl + race_cat + ethn_child + income_cat + edu_cat,
  data = ipw_check_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(ipw_model)

# Create stabilized weights
ipw_check_data <- ipw_check_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ps_father = predict(ipw_model, type = "response")
  )

p_father <- mean(ipw_check_data$father_sample == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
p_mother <- mean(ipw_check_data$father_sample == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

ipw_check_data <- ipw_check_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sw = dplyr::case_when(
      father_sample == 1 ~ p_father / ps_father,
      father_sample == 0 ~ p_mother / (1 - ps_father),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    sw_trim = pmin(sw, quantile(sw, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

summary(ipw_check_data$sw)
summary(ipw_check_data$sw_trim)

quantile(
  ipw_check_data$sw,
  probs = c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.50, 0.95, 0.99, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Merge IPW weights back into mother/father analysis data
ipw_weights <- ipw_check_data %>%
  dplyr::select(subjectkey, caregiver_group, sw, sw_trim)

analysis_data_mf_ipw <- analysis_data_mf %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    ipw_weights,
    by = c("subjectkey", "caregiver_group")
  )

data_mother_ipw <- analysis_data_mf_ipw %>%
  dplyr::filter(caregiver_group == "mother")

data_father_ipw <- analysis_data_mf_ipw %>%
  dplyr::filter(caregiver_group == "father")

# Fit weighted CLPM models
fit_int_mother_ipw <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_int_cov,
  data = data_mother_ipw,
  missing = "fiml",
  sampling.weights = "sw_trim"
)

fit_int_father_ipw <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_int_cov,
  data = data_father_ipw,
  missing = "fiml",
  sampling.weights = "sw_trim"
)

fit_ext_mother_ipw <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_ext_cov,
  data = data_mother_ipw,
  missing = "fiml",
  sampling.weights = "sw_trim"
)

fit_ext_father_ipw <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_ext_cov,
  data = data_father_ipw,
  missing = "fiml",
  sampling.weights = "sw_trim"
)

# Check convergence
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_int_mother_ipw, "converged")
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_int_father_ipw, "converged")
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_ext_mother_ipw, "converged")
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_ext_father_ipw, "converged")

# Extract weighted cross-lagged results
parent_results_ipw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_parent_paths(
    fit = fit_int_mother_ipw,
    get_fun = get_crosslag_int,
    outcome = "Child internalizing",
    caregiver = "mother"
  ),
  extract_parent_paths(
    fit = fit_int_father_ipw,
    get_fun = get_crosslag_int,
    outcome = "Child internalizing",
    caregiver = "father"
  ),
  extract_parent_paths(
    fit = fit_ext_mother_ipw,
    get_fun = get_crosslag_ext,
    outcome = "Child externalizing",
    caregiver = "mother"
  ),
  extract_parent_paths(
    fit = fit_ext_father_ipw,
    get_fun = get_crosslag_ext,
    outcome = "Child externalizing",
    caregiver = "father"
  )
)

parent_results_ipw

# Compare original vs IPW estimates
parent_results_compare_ipw <- parent_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(std_unweighted = std.all) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    parent_results_ipw %>%
      dplyr::rename(std_ipw = std.all),
    by = c("outcome", "caregiver_group", "lhs", "rhs")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference = std_ipw - std_unweighted
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(outcome, caregiver_group, lhs, rhs)

parent_results_compare_ipw

```

Stabilized inverse probability weights indicated good overlap between the mother-child and father-child samples.
The weighted models yielded nearly identical results to the primary analyses, suggesting that the findings were not driven by differences in sample composition.

## IPW split-half validation

```{r}
n_iter_ipw <- 5000

ipw_split_path <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "split_parent_ipw_results_5000.rds"
)

ipw_split_summary_path <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "parent_ipw_split_summary_5000.rds"
)

run_one_split_parent_ipw <- function(data, model, get_fun, weight_var = "sw_trim") {
  
  n <- nrow(data)
  group_A_id <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(n / 2), replace = FALSE)
  
  data_A <- data[group_A_id, ]
  data_B <- data[-group_A_id, ]
  
  fit_A <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      lavaan::sem(
        model,
        data = data_A,
        missing = "fiml",
        sampling.weights = weight_var,
        em.h1.iter.max = 5000
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  fit_B <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      lavaan::sem(
        model,
        data = data_B,
        missing = "fiml",
        sampling.weights = weight_var,
        em.h1.iter.max = 5000
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit_A) | is.null(fit_B)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      lhs = character(),
      rhs = character(),
      std_A = numeric(),
      std_B = numeric(),
      same_direction = logical(),
      mean_abs_effect = numeric()
    ))
  }
  
  if (!lavaan::lavInspect(fit_A, "converged") |
      !lavaan::lavInspect(fit_B, "converged")) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      lhs = character(),
      rhs = character(),
      std_A = numeric(),
      std_B = numeric(),
      same_direction = logical(),
      mean_abs_effect = numeric()
    ))
  }
  
  est_A <- get_fun(fit_A) %>%
    dplyr::rename(std_A = std.all)
  
  est_B <- get_fun(fit_B) %>%
    dplyr::rename(std_B = std.all)
  
  est_A %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(est_B, by = c("lhs", "rhs")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      same_direction = sign(std_A) == sign(std_B),
      mean_abs_effect = (abs(std_A) + abs(std_B)) / 2
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_split_parent_model_parallel_ipw <- function(
    data,
    model,
    get_fun,
    outcome,
    caregiver,
    n_iter = 1000,
    weight_var = "sw_trim"
) {
  
  foreach(
    i = seq_len(n_iter),
    .combine = dplyr::bind_rows,
    .packages = c("lavaan", "dplyr", "tibble"),
    .export = c(
      "run_one_split_parent_ipw",
      "get_crosslag_int",
      "get_crosslag_ext"
    )
  ) %dopar% {
    
    out <- tryCatch(
      run_one_split_parent_ipw(
        data = data,
        model = model,
        get_fun = get_fun,
        weight_var = weight_var
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        tibble::tibble(
          lhs = character(),
          rhs = character(),
          std_A = numeric(),
          std_B = numeric(),
          same_direction = logical(),
          mean_abs_effect = numeric()
        )
      }
    )
    
    out %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        iter = i,
        outcome = outcome,
        caregiver_group = caregiver
      )
  }
}
```

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )
}

format_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Extract standardized estimates and p-values from CLPMs

extract_parent_paths_with_p <- function(fit, get_fun, outcome, caregiver) {
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble::tibble())
  }
  
  path_keep <- get_fun(fit) %>%
    dplyr::select(lhs, rhs)
  
  standardizedSolution(fit, ci = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(op == "~") %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(path_keep, by = c("lhs", "rhs")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome = outcome,
      caregiver_group = caregiver,
      pathway = paste(rhs, "→", lhs),
      std_beta = est.std,
      p_value = pvalue
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      lhs,
      rhs,
      pathway,
      std_beta,
      p_value
    )
}

parent_est_unweighted <- dplyr::bind_rows(
```

```{r}
# Calculate Z-scores from existing split-half results

summarize_parent_split_correlation_z <- function(split_results) {
  
  split_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(std_A),
      !is.na(std_B)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      iter
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_paths = dplyr::n(),
      split_half_r = dplyr::case_when(
        n_paths >= 2 &&
          stats::sd(std_A, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 &&
          stats::sd(std_B, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~
          stats::cor(std_A, std_B, use = "complete.obs"),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(split_half_r)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_successful = dplyr::n(),
      mean_split_half_r = mean(split_half_r, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_split_half_r = stats::sd(split_half_r, na.rm = TRUE),
      z_score = abs(mean_split_half_r / sd_split_half_r),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

parent_split_z_unweighted <- summarize_parent_split_correlation_z(
  split_parent_results
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    n_successful_unweighted = n_successful,
    mean_r_unweighted = mean_split_half_r,
    sd_r_unweighted = sd_split_half_r,
    z_unweighted = z_score
  )

parent_split_z_ipw <- summarize_parent_split_correlation_z(
  split_parent_ipw_results
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    n_successful_ipw = n_successful,
    mean_r_ipw = mean_split_half_r,
    sd_r_ipw = sd_split_half_r,
    z_ipw = z_score
  )

parent_split_z_compare_ipw <- parent_split_z_unweighted %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    parent_split_z_ipw,
    by = c("outcome", "caregiver_group")
  )

parent_split_z_compare_ipw
```

Propensity score weighting produced highly similar split-half reproducibility estimates to the primary analyses. Mother-child models showed nearly identical reproducibility classifications and same-direction rates, whereas modest improvements in reproducibility were observed for several father-child pathways. Overall, the pattern of findings remained unchanged after weighting.

```{r}
calculate_parent_path_pearson_components <- function(split_results) {

  split_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(std_A),
      is.finite(std_B)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      iter
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_paths = dplyr::n(),

      mean_std_A = mean(std_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_std_B = mean(std_B, na.rm = TRUE),

      sd_std_A = stats::sd(std_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_std_B = stats::sd(std_B, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_paths >= 2,
      is.finite(sd_std_A),
      is.finite(sd_std_B),
      sd_std_A > 0,
      sd_std_B > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      standardized_A =
        (std_A - mean_std_A) / sd_std_A,

      standardized_B =
        (std_B - mean_std_B) / sd_std_B,

      # Contributions sum to the model-level Pearson r
      pearson_component =
        (standardized_A * standardized_B) / (n_paths - 1),

      pathway = paste(rhs, "→", lhs)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

summarize_parent_split_path_pearson_z <- function(split_results) {

  component_data <-
    calculate_parent_path_pearson_components(split_results)

  component_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      lhs,
      rhs,
      pathway
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_successful = dplyr::n_distinct(iter),

      mean_pearson_component =
        mean(pearson_component, na.rm = TRUE),

      sd_pearson_component =
        stats::sd(pearson_component, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # Match the existing model-level definition:
      # absolute mean divided by SD
      path_specific_z = dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(sd_pearson_component) &
          sd_pearson_component > 0,
        abs(mean_pearson_component / sd_pearson_component),
        NA_real_
      ),

      contribution_direction = dplyr::case_when(
        mean_pearson_component > 0 ~ "Agreement",
        mean_pearson_component < 0 ~ "Disagreement",
        TRUE ~ "Neutral"
      )
    )
}

parent_split_z_unweighted <-
  summarize_parent_split_path_pearson_z(
    split_parent_results
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    n_successful_unweighted = n_successful,

    mean_pearson_component_unweighted =
      mean_pearson_component,

    sd_pearson_component_unweighted =
      sd_pearson_component,

    direction_unweighted =
      contribution_direction,

    z_unweighted =
      path_specific_z
  )

parent_split_z_ipw <-
  summarize_parent_split_path_pearson_z(
    split_parent_ipw_results
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    n_successful_ipw = n_successful,

    mean_pearson_component_ipw =
      mean_pearson_component,

    sd_pearson_component_ipw =
      sd_pearson_component,

    direction_ipw =
      contribution_direction,

    z_ipw =
      path_specific_z
  )

parent_split_z_compare_ipw <-
  parent_split_z_unweighted %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    parent_split_z_ipw,
    by = c(
      "outcome",
      "caregiver_group",
      "lhs",
      "rhs",
      "pathway"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    outcome,
    caregiver_group,
    pathway
  )

parent_split_z_compare_ipw

summary(parent_split_z_compare_ipw$z_unweighted)
summary(parent_split_z_compare_ipw$z_ipw)

any(
  parent_split_z_compare_ipw$z_unweighted < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

any(
  parent_split_z_compare_ipw$z_ipw < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

check_parent_path_pearson_components <- function(split_results) {

  component_data <-
    calculate_parent_path_pearson_components(split_results)

  component_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      outcome,
      caregiver_group,
      iter
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      direct_pearson_r = stats::cor(
        std_A,
        std_B,
        use = "complete.obs"
      ),

      component_sum =
        sum(pearson_component, na.rm = TRUE),

      difference =
        component_sum - direct_pearson_r,

      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

unweighted_pearson_check <-
  check_parent_path_pearson_components(

  ) %>%

      "unweighted and IPW-weighted CLPMs. Difference was ",
      "calculated as IPW standardized β minus unweighted ",
      "standardized β."
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = c(
        `Unweighted standardized β`,
        `IPW standardized β`,
        `Difference in standardized β`
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0(
      "Within each split-half iteration, the Pearson correlation ",
      "between the vectors of standardized cross-lagged path estimates ",
      "from split A and split B was decomposed into pathway-specific ",
      "contributions. The path-specific Z-score was calculated as the ",
      "absolute mean pathway-specific Pearson-correlation contribution ",
      "divided by its standard deviation across 5,000 iterations. Larger ",
      "values indicate a more stable contribution of that pathway to the ",
      "overall split-half Pearson correlation. These values should not be ",
      "interpreted as pathway-specific Pearson correlations, effect sizes, ",
      "or tests of statistical significance for individual paths."
      ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_labels(
      columns = c(
        `Unweighted path-specific Z-score`,
```

```{r}
        ethn_child,
        income_cat,
        edu_cat
      ),
    by = "subjectkey"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cbcl_8_baseline_bin,
    by = "subjectkey"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    parent_t %>%
      dplyr::select(
        subjectkey,
        parent_internalizing_bin,
        parent_externalizing_bin
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = "subjectkey"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(
        cbcl_anxdep_bl,
        cbcl_withdep_bl,
        cbcl_somatic_bl,
        cbcl_social_bl,
        cbcl_thought_bl,
        cbcl_attention_bl,
        cbcl_rulebreak_bl,
        cbcl_aggressive_bl,
        parent_internalizing_bin,
        parent_externalizing_bin
      ),
      ~ factor(
        .x,
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("Not elevated", "Elevated")
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
table_s_missingness_chisq <- missingness_chisq_data %>%

  gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    by = missing_data_group,

      )
```
