```{r}
    label ~ "**Variable**",
    p.value ~ "**p-value**"

  gtsummary::modify_caption(

  ) %>%
  gtsummary::modify_footnote(
    gtsummary::all_stat_cols() ~
      "Values are n (%). Complete data indicates participants with complete CBCL data across all six Aim 1 waves. Partially missing data indicates participants retained in the LTA analytic sample with CBCL data available for at least three waves but not all six waves. CBCL indicators reflect baseline dichotomized syndrome-scale endorsement. Percentages are calculated among participants with non-missing data for each variable. Chi-square tests used simulated p-values with 10,000 replicates."
  ) %>%
  gtsummary::bold_labels()

table_s_missingness_chisq %>%
  gtsummary::as_gt()
```

```{r}
# Compare parent-to-child vs child-to-parent cross-lagged paths

analysis_data_std <- analysis_data %>%
```

```{r}
# Child internalizing model with labeled cross-lagged paths

model_3f_child_int_eq <- '

# autoregressive paths
child_int_02A ~ child_int_00A
child_int_04A ~ child_int_02A

parent_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

# cross-lag paths with labels

# Parent internalizing <-> Child internalizing
child_int_02A ~ p2c_int_1*parent_int_00A + p2c_ext_1*parent_ext_00A
child_int_04A ~ p2c_int_2*parent_int_02A + p2c_ext_2*parent_ext_02A

parent_int_02A ~ c2p_int_1*child_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_04A ~ c2p_int_2*child_int_02A + parent_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ c2p_ext_1*child_int_00A + parent_int_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ c2p_ext_2*child_int_02A + parent_int_02A

# covariates constrained equal across time
child_int_02A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu
child_int_04A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu

parent_int_02A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu
parent_int_04A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu

parent_ext_02A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu
parent_ext_04A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu

# within-wave correlations
child_int_00A ~~ parent_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_00A ~~ parent_ext_00A

child_int_02A ~~ parent_int_02A + parent_ext_02A
parent_int_02A ~~ parent_ext_02A

child_int_04A ~~ parent_int_04A + parent_ext_04A
parent_int_04A ~~ parent_ext_04A
'

fit_3f_child_int_eq <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_int_eq,
  data = analysis_data_std,
  missing = "fiml"
)
```

```{r}
# Child externalizing model with labeled cross-lagged paths

model_3f_child_ext_eq <- '

# autoregressive paths
child_ext_02A ~ child_ext_00A
child_ext_04A ~ child_ext_02A

parent_int_02A ~ parent_int_00A
parent_int_04A ~ parent_int_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ parent_ext_02A

# cross-lag paths with labels

# Parent internalizing/externalizing -> Child externalizing
child_ext_02A ~ p2c_int_1*parent_int_00A + p2c_ext_1*parent_ext_00A
child_ext_04A ~ p2c_int_2*parent_int_02A + p2c_ext_2*parent_ext_02A

# Child externalizing -> Parent internalizing/externalizing
parent_int_02A ~ c2p_int_1*child_ext_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_04A ~ c2p_int_2*child_ext_02A + parent_ext_02A

parent_ext_02A ~ c2p_ext_1*child_ext_00A + parent_int_00A
parent_ext_04A ~ c2p_ext_2*child_ext_02A + parent_int_02A

# covariates constrained equal across time
child_ext_02A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu
child_ext_04A ~ c1*sex_num + c2*age_bl + c3*parent_edu

parent_int_02A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu
parent_int_04A ~ p1*sex_num + p2*age_bl + p3*parent_edu

parent_ext_02A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu
parent_ext_04A ~ e1*sex_num + e2*age_bl + e3*parent_edu

# within-wave correlations
child_ext_00A ~~ parent_int_00A + parent_ext_00A
parent_int_00A ~~ parent_ext_00A

child_ext_02A ~~ parent_int_02A + parent_ext_02A
parent_int_02A ~~ parent_ext_02A

child_ext_04A ~~ parent_int_04A + parent_ext_04A
parent_int_04A ~~ parent_ext_04A
'

fit_3f_child_ext_eq <- lavaan::sem(
  model_3f_child_ext_eq,
  data = analysis_data_std,
  missing = "fiml"
)
```

```{r}
# Wald equality test

extract_labeled_est <- function(fit, label_name) {
  
  lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit) %>%
    dplyr::filter(label == label_name) %>%
    dplyr::pull(est) %>%
    .[1]
}

run_wald_test_simple <- function(
    fit,
    constraint,
    p2c_label,
    c2p_label,
    outcome,
    parent_domain,
    child_domain,
    time_interval
) {
  
  out <- lavaan::lavTestWald(
    fit,
    constraints = constraint
  )
  
  p2c_est <- extract_labeled_est(fit, p2c_label)
  c2p_est <- extract_labeled_est(fit, c2p_label)
  
  tibble::tibble(
    Outcome = outcome,
    `Parent domain` = parent_domain,
    `Child domain` = child_domain,
    `Time interval` = time_interval,
    `Parent -> child beta` = p2c_est,
    `Child -> parent beta` = c2p_est,
    `Stronger direction` = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(p2c_est) | is.na(c2p_est) ~ NA_character_,
      abs(p2c_est) > abs(c2p_est) ~ "Parent -> child",
      abs(c2p_est) > abs(p2c_est) ~ "Child -> parent",
      TRUE ~ "Equal"
    ),
    Chisq = unname(out$stat),
    df = unname(out$df),
    p_value = unname(out$p.value)
  )
}
```

```{r}
multi_parent_class_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  results_low_ref,
  results_high_mod
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z = beta / SE,
    p_value = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z))),
    OR = exp(beta),
    CI_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * SE),
    CI_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * SE),
    p_value_formatted = dplyr::case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Predictor,
    OR,
    CI_lower,
    CI_upper,
    p_value_formatted
  )
```

```{r}
multi_parent_traj_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  results_stable_ref,
  results_imp_ref,
  results_fluc_wor
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    z = beta / SE,
    p_value = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z))),
    OR = exp(beta),
    CI_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * SE),
    CI_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * SE),

    p_value_formatted = dplyr::case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Predictor,
    OR,
    CI_lower,
    CI_upper,
    p_value_formatted
  )
```

```{r}
      "]"

  gt::tab_caption(
    "Supplementary Table. Baseline parent psychopathology predicting child longitudinal trajectory type"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0(
      "Multinomial logistic regression was used to examine associations between baseline parent psychopathology ",
      "and child longitudinal trajectory type. Models were refit using alternative reference groups to obtain ",
      "all pairwise trajectory comparisons. Parent ASR internalizing and externalizing scores were standardized, ",
      "so odds ratios reflect the change in odds of membership in the first trajectory group relative to the second ",
      "per 1-SD increase in parent symptoms. Models adjusted for child sex, child age at baseline, household income, ",
      "and parental education. Estimates for the parental education Missing/Declined category were not displayed ",
      "because of sparse cell counts across trajectory groups."
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(
      groups = "title"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(subjectkey, income_cat) %>%

    income_clean = as.character(income_cat),
    income_clean = gsub("–", "-", income_clean),
    
    income_3cat = dplyr::case_when(
      income_clean %in% c("<$25k", "$25k-$49,999") ~ "<$50k",
      income_clean %in% c("$50k-$99,999") ~ "$50k–$99,999",

    ),

    )
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# Build stratified trajectory dataset

normalize_class_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    as.character(x) %in% c("Low", "Low symptom group") ~ "Low",
    as.character(x) %in% c("Moderate", "Moderate symptoms") ~ "Moderate",
    as.character(x) %in% c("High", "High symptom group") ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

  dplyr::select(subjectkey, dplyr::all_of(lv_cols)) %>%

      dplyr::select(subjectkey, TrajectoryType),
    by = "subjectkey"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    demo_full %>%
      dplyr::select(subjectkey, sex),
    by = "subjectkey"

  dplyr::left_join(
    income_3cat_df,

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(lv_cols),
      ~ factor(normalize_class_label(.x), levels = class_levels)
    ),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = sex_levels),
    income_3cat = factor(income_3cat, levels = income_3_levels),

      as.character(TrajectoryType),

stratified_traj_df %>%
  dplyr::count(income_3cat)
```

```{r}
# Chi-square tests for stratified supplementary tables

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
  )
}

get_chisq_p <- function(data, strata_var, outcome_var, strata_label) {
  
  test_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[strata_var]]),
      !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]])
    )
  
  chisq_tab <- table(
    test_data[[strata_var]],
    test_data[[outcome_var]]
  )
  
  chisq_result <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::chisq.test(chisq_tab)
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    Stratification = strata_label,
    `Chi-square p-value` = format_p_value(chisq_result$p.value)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Trajectory type summary by child sex and income

summarize_trajectory_type_by <- function(data, strata_var, strata_label, strata_levels) {
  
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Stratification = strata_label,
      Stratum = factor(
        as.character(.data[[strata_var]]),
        levels = strata_levels
      ),
      TrajectoryType = factor(
        as.character(TrajectoryType),
        levels = trajectory_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Stratum), !is.na(TrajectoryType)) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Stratification,
      Stratum,
      TrajectoryType,
      name = "Count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Stratification, Stratum) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Percent = round(100 * Count / sum(Count), 1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Stratum, TrajectoryType)
}
```

```{r}
# Alluvial plot function

plot_alluvial_by_strata <- function(
    data,
    strata_var,
    strata_levels,
    title_text,
    nrow_facet = 1
) {
  
  plot_df <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Stratum = factor(
        as.character(.data[[strata_var]]),
        levels = strata_levels
      ),
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(lv_cols),
        ~ factor(as.character(.x), levels = class_levels)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Stratum)) %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Stratum,
      L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, L6,
      name = "freq"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Stratum)
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      axis1 = L1,
      axis2 = L2,
      axis3 = L3,
      axis4 = L4,
      axis5 = L5,
      axis6 = L6,
      y = freq
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c("Baseline", "1-year", "2-year", "3-year", "4-year", "5-year"),
      expand = c(.05, .05)
    ) +
    ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(
      ggplot2::aes(fill = L1),
      alpha = 0.60,
      knot.pos = 0.4
    ) +
    ggalluvial::geom_stratum(
      width = 0.28,
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      stat = "stratum",
      ggplot2::aes(label = ggplot2::after_stat(stratum)),
      size = 3.3
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~ Stratum,
      nrow = nrow_facet,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of participants",
      fill = "Baseline class"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.0, "lines"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

## RI-CLPM

### RI-CLPM internalizing

```{r}
model_ri_int <- '

# random intercepts
RI_child_int =~ 1*child_int_00A + 1*child_int_02A + 1*child_int_04A
RI_parent_int =~ 1*parent_int_00A + 1*parent_int_02A + 1*parent_int_04A

# within-person components
w_child_int_00 =~ 1*child_int_00A
w_child_int_02 =~ 1*child_int_02A
w_child_int_04 =~ 1*child_int_04A

w_parent_int_00 =~ 1*parent_int_00A
w_parent_int_02 =~ 1*parent_int_02A
w_parent_int_04 =~ 1*parent_int_04A

# residual variances
child_int_00A ~~ 0*child_int_00A
child_int_02A ~~ 0*child_int_02A
child_int_04A ~~ 0*child_int_04A

parent_int_00A ~~ 0*parent_int_00A
parent_int_02A ~~ 0*parent_int_02A
parent_int_04A ~~ 0*parent_int_04A

# autoregressive and cross-lagged paths
w_child_int_02 ~ w_child_int_00 + w_parent_int_00
w_child_int_04 ~ w_child_int_02 + w_parent_int_02

w_parent_int_02 ~ w_parent_int_00 + w_child_int_00
w_parent_int_04 ~ w_parent_int_02 + w_child_int_02

# within-wave correlations
w_child_int_00 ~~ w_parent_int_00
w_child_int_02 ~~ w_parent_int_02
w_child_int_04 ~~ w_parent_int_04

# random intercept correlation
RI_child_int ~~ RI_parent_int

# random intercepts orthogonal to baseline within-person components
RI_child_int ~~ 0*w_child_int_00
RI_child_int ~~ 0*w_parent_int_00
RI_parent_int ~~ 0*w_child_int_00
RI_parent_int ~~ 0*w_parent_int_00

'
```

```{r}
model_ri_ext <- '

# random intercepts

RI_parent_ext =~ 1*parent_ext_00A + 1*parent_ext_02A + 1*parent_ext_04A

# within-person components

w_child_ext_02 =~ 1*child_ext_02A
w_child_ext_04 =~ 1*child_ext_04A

w_parent_ext_00 =~ 1*parent_ext_00A
w_parent_ext_02 =~ 1*parent_ext_02A
w_parent_ext_04 =~ 1*parent_ext_04A

# residual variances
child_ext_00A ~~ 0*child_ext_00A
child_ext_02A ~~ 0*child_ext_02A
child_ext_04A ~~ 0*child_ext_04A

parent_ext_00A ~~ 0*parent_ext_00A
parent_ext_02A ~~ 0*parent_ext_02A
parent_ext_04A ~~ 0*parent_ext_04A

# autoregressive and cross-lagged paths
w_child_ext_02 ~ w_child_ext_00 + w_parent_ext_00

w_parent_ext_02 ~ w_parent_ext_00 + w_child_ext_00

# within-wave correlations
w_child_ext_00 ~~ w_parent_ext_00
w_child_ext_02 ~~ w_parent_ext_02
w_child_ext_04 ~~ w_parent_ext_04

# random intercept correlation
RI_child_ext ~~ RI_parent_ext

RI_child_ext ~~ 0*w_child_ext_00
RI_child_ext ~~ 0*w_parent_ext_00
RI_parent_ext ~~ 0*w_child_ext_00
RI_parent_ext ~~ 0*w_parent_ext_00
```

```{r}
# Extract transition probabilities

params_sibling <- param(fit_k3_sibling)
tau_obj_sibling <- params_sibling$tau

tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- NULL

if (is.list(tau_obj_sibling)) {
  tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    tau_obj_sibling,
    function(M, edge) {
      as_tibble(M, rownames = "child") |>
        pivot_longer(
          -child,
          names_to = "parent",
          values_to = "value_raw"
        ) |>
        mutate(edge = edge)
    }
  )
} else if (
  is.array(tau_obj_sibling) &&
    length(dim(tau_obj_sibling)) == 3
) {
  kmax <- dim(tau_obj_sibling)[3]

  tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- purrr::map_dfr(
    1:kmax,
    function(k) {
      as_tibble(
        tau_obj_sibling[, , k],
        rownames = "child"
      ) |>
        pivot_longer(
          -child,
          names_to = "parent",
          values_to = "value_raw"
        ) |>
        mutate(edge = paste0("edge_", k))
    }
  )
} else if (is.matrix(tau_obj_sibling)) {

  tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- as_tibble(
    tau_obj_sibling,
    rownames = "child"
  ) |>
    pivot_longer(
      -child,
      names_to = "parent",
      values_to = "value_raw"
    ) |>
    mutate(edge = "common")

} else {
  stop("Unknown tau object structure.")
}

tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- tidy_tau_raw_sibling %>%
  mutate(
    child = as.integer(child),
    parent = as.integer(parent)
  ) %>%
  group_by(edge, parent) %>%
  mutate(
    prob = value_raw / sum(value_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
  rownames(P_baseline_sibling)[ord_base_sibling]

  ord_base_sibling,
  ,
  drop = FALSE

map_baseline_sibling <- tibble::tibble(
  Time_code = baseline_code_sibling,
  Class = baseline_class_ids_sibling,

    ],
    levels = stable_labels

map_baseline_sibling
```

```{r}
make_map_one_sibling <- function(
    df,
    time_code,
    baseline_proto_sibling,
    stable_labels
) {

  if (time_code == baseline_code_sibling) {
    return(map_baseline_sibling)
  }

  P_t <- get_proto(
    df,
    time_code
  )

  common_cols <- intersect(
    colnames(baseline_proto_sibling),
    colnames(P_t)
  )

  if (length(common_cols) == 0) {
    warning(
      paste(
        "No common columns for time_code:",
        time_code
      )
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  baseline_aligned <- baseline_proto_sibling[
    ,
    common_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  P_t_aligned <- P_t[
    ,
    common_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  perms <- list(
    c(1, 2, 3),
    c(1, 3, 2),
    c(2, 1, 3),
    c(2, 3, 1),
    c(3, 1, 2),
    c(3, 2, 1)
  )

  best_cost <- Inf
  best_perm <- NULL

  for (perm in perms) {

    P_t_perm <- P_t_aligned[
      as.character(perm),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    cost <- sum(
      (baseline_aligned - P_t_perm)^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    if (cost < best_cost) {
      best_cost <- cost
      best_perm <- perm
    }
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    Time_code = time_code,
    Class = as.integer(best_perm),
    Label = factor(
      stable_labels,
      levels = stable_labels
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
tidy_tau_raw_sibling <- tidy_tau_raw_sibling %>%
  dplyr::filter(edge %in% edge_levels_sibling)

edge_time_map_sibling <- tibble::tibble(
  edge = edge_levels_sibling,
  from_code = time_codes_sibling[1:length(edge_levels_sibling)],
  to_code = time_codes_sibling[2:(length(edge_levels_sibling) + 1)]
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map_sibling %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        from_code = Time_code,
        from_lab = Time_label
      ),
    by = "from_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    time_map_sibling %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        to_code = Time_code,
        to_lab = Time_label
      ),
    by = "to_code"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    edge_label = paste(from_lab, "->", to_lab)
  )
```

```{r}
class_id_map_sibling <- map_all_sibling %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    class_id = dplyr::case_when(
      as.character(Label) == "Low symptom group" ~ 1L,
      as.character(Label) == "Moderate symptoms" ~ 2L,
      as.character(Label) == "High symptom group" ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Time_code,
    Class,
    class_id
  )

tidy_tau_aligned_sibling <- tidy_tau_raw_sibling %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    edge_time_map_sibling %>%
      dplyr::select(
        edge,
        from_code,
        to_code,
        edge_label
      ),
    by = "edge"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    class_id_map_sibling %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        from_code = Time_code,
        parent = Class,
        parent_id = class_id
      ),
    by = c("from_code", "parent")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    class_id_map_sibling %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        to_code = Time_code,
        child = Class,
        child_id = class_id
      ),
    by = c("to_code", "child")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(parent_id),
    !is.na(child_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    parent_label = factor(
      c(
        "Low symptom group",
        "Moderate symptoms",
        "High symptom group"
      )[parent_id],
      levels = stable_labels
    ),
    child_label = factor(
      c(
        "Low symptom group",
        "Moderate symptoms",
        "High symptom group"
      )[child_id],
      levels = stable_labels
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Sibling sensitivity trajectory classification

traj_base_sibling <- posterior_k3_df_labeled_sibling %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    subjectkey,
    L1 = forcats::fct_relevel(L1, stable_labels),
    L2 = forcats::fct_relevel(L2, stable_labels),
    L3 = forcats::fct_relevel(L3, stable_labels),
    L4 = forcats::fct_relevel(L4, stable_labels),
    L5 = forcats::fct_relevel(L5, stable_labels),
    L6 = forcats::fct_relevel(L6, stable_labels)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    L1n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L1)]),
    L2n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L2)]),
    L3n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L3)]),
    L4n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L4)]),
    L5n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L5)]),
    L6n = unname(rank_map[as.character(L6)])
  )

traj_type_df_sibling <- traj_base_sibling %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TrajectoryType = classify_path(
      c(L1n, L2n, L3n, L4n, L5n, L6n)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    subjectkey,
    TrajectoryType
  )
```

# CLPM vs RI-CLPM comparison

```{r}
clpm_compare_int <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(
  fit_3f_child_int_cov,
  ci = TRUE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    op == "~",
    (lhs == "child_int_02A" & rhs == "parent_int_00A") |
      (lhs == "child_int_04A" & rhs == "parent_int_02A") |
      (lhs == "parent_int_02A" & rhs == "child_int_00A") |
      (lhs == "parent_int_04A" & rhs == "child_int_02A")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Model = "Child internalizing",

    Pathway = dplyr::case_when(
      lhs == "child_int_02A" & rhs == "parent_int_00A" ~
        "Parent internalizing, baseline → Child internalizing, 2-year",

      lhs == "child_int_04A" & rhs == "parent_int_02A" ~
        "Parent internalizing, 2-year → Child internalizing, 4-year",

      lhs == "parent_int_02A" & rhs == "child_int_00A" ~
        "Child internalizing, baseline → Parent internalizing, 2-year",

      lhs == "parent_int_04A" & rhs == "child_int_02A" ~
        "Child internalizing, 2-year → Parent internalizing, 4-year"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Model,
    Pathway,
    beta_CLPM = est.std,
    p_CLPM = pvalue
  )
```

```{r}
    significant_CLPM =
```

# Participant flow: reproducible sample counts

```{r}
# Raw CBCL sample
n_flow_raw <- cbcl_long_raw %>%
  dplyr::distinct(participant_id) %>%
  nrow()


# Aim 1 LTA analytic sample
n_flow_aim1 <- nrow(cbcl_wide_k3)

n_flow_excluded_cbcl <- n_flow_raw - n_flow_aim1


# Number of participants by number of complete CBCL waves
flow_wave_counts <- tp_complete_table %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    n_complete_waves = `Number of complete time points`,
    n = `Number of participants`
  )

n_flow_1wave <- flow_wave_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_complete_waves == 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)

n_flow_2waves <- flow_wave_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_complete_waves == 2) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)

n_flow_3to5 <- flow_wave_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_complete_waves %in% 3:5) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)

n_flow_6waves <- flow_wave_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_complete_waves == 6) %>%
  dplyr::pull(n)


# Aim 2 overall CLPM sample
n_flow_aim2 <- as.integer(
  lavaan::lavInspect(fit_3f_child_int_cov, "nobs")
)

n_flow_aim2_ext <- as.integer(
  lavaan::lavInspect(fit_3f_child_ext_cov, "nobs")
)


# Biological mother/father analyses
n_flow_mother <- dplyr::n_distinct(data_mother$subjectkey)
n_flow_father <- dplyr::n_distinct(data_father$subjectkey)

n_flow_mf <- n_flow_mother + n_flow_father

n_flow_excluded_mf <- n_flow_aim2 - n_flow_mf

stopifnot(
  n_flow_1wave + n_flow_2waves == n_flow_excluded_cbcl,
  n_flow_3to5 + n_flow_6waves == n_flow_aim1,
  n_flow_aim2 == n_flow_aim2_ext,
  n_flow_mother + n_flow_father == n_flow_mf
)


# Display all counts
flow_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c(
    "Participants with CBCL records",
    "Excluded: insufficient longitudinal CBCL data",
    "  - 1 complete wave",
    "  - 2 complete waves",
    "Aim 1 LTA analytic sample",
    "  - Partial data retained (3-5 complete waves)",
    "  - Complete data (6 waves)",
    "Aim 2 overall parent-child CLPM",
    "Excluded from biological mother/father stratified analyses",
    "Biological mother caregiver",
    "Biological father caregiver"
  ),
  N = c(
    n_flow_raw,
    n_flow_excluded_cbcl,
    n_flow_1wave,
    n_flow_2waves,
    n_flow_aim1,
    n_flow_3to5,
    n_flow_6waves,
    n_flow_aim2,
    n_flow_excluded_mf,
    n_flow_mother,
    n_flow_father
  )
)

flow_counts
```

```{r}
# Supplementary participant flow diagram

flow_diagram <- DiagrammeR::grViz(
  sprintf(
'
digraph participant_flow {

  graph [
    layout = dot,
    rankdir = TB,
    nodesep = 0.45,
    ranksep = 0.60
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = "rounded,filled",
    fillcolor = "white",
    color = "black",
    fontname = "Arial",
    fontsize = 11,
    margin = 0.18
  ]

  edge [
    color = "black",
    arrowsize = 0.7
  ]


  raw [
    label = "Participants with CBCL records\\nN = %s"
  ]


  excluded_cbcl [
    label = "Excluded: insufficient longitudinal CBCL data\\nn = %s\\n\\n1 complete wave: n = %s\\n2 complete waves: n = %s"
  ]


  aim1 [
    label = "Aim 1: LTA analytic sample\\nN = %s\\n\\nComplete 6-wave data: n = %s\\nPartial 3–5-wave data: n = %s"
  ]


  aim2 [
    label = "Aim 2: Overall parent-child CLPM\\nN = %s"
  ]


  excluded_mf [
    label = "Excluded from biological mother/father\\ncaregiver-specific analyses\\n\\nOther or missing caregiver classification\\nn = %s"
  ]


  mf [
    label = "Biological mother/father\\ncaregiver-specific analyses\\nN = %s"
  ]


  mother [
    label = "Biological mother\\nn = %s"
  ]


  father [
    label = "Biological father\\nn = %s"
  ]


  raw -> aim1
  raw -> excluded_cbcl [style = dashed]

  aim1 -> aim2

  aim2 -> mf
  aim2 -> excluded_mf [style = dashed]

  mf -> mother
  mf -> father


  {rank = same; aim1; excluded_cbcl}
  {rank = same; mf; excluded_mf}
  {rank = same; mother; father}
}
',
    format(n_flow_raw, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_excluded_cbcl, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_1wave, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_2waves, big.mark = ","),

    format(n_flow_aim1, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_6waves, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_3to5, big.mark = ","),

    format(n_flow_aim2, big.mark = ","),

    format(n_flow_excluded_mf, big.mark = ","),

    format(n_flow_mf, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_mother, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_flow_father, big.mark = ",")
  )
)

flow_diagram
```
